# 3. Every endpoint

> Generated by `npm run generate:backend-guidelines` from
> `src/services/endpoints.js` and `src/services/schemas/` — do not edit.
> generatedFrom: a732c3c

252 endpoints, one section each: the path, who may call it, the
query parameters it accepts, the body it validates — as Laravel rule strings —
a real response captured from the running mock, the errors it can answer with,
and what it changes besides answering.

The envelopes (§5.2), the error body (§5.3) and the pagination rules (§5.6) are
in `01_API_CONTRACT.md` and are not repeated here.

**About the examples.** Each one is a real request against the mock, seeded from
the `db.json` in this package. Arrays are cut to two items and long strings to
300 characters so a section stays readable, and every timestamp is normalised to
one fixed instant so that regenerating this file produces no diff. Read them for
shape and naming, never for values.

## Module: articles

### GET /articles

> Published articles, newest or most read first

- **Registry key** `articles.list`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `ArticleList`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter      | Type                 | Default                            | Allowed values      |
| -------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `authorId`     | int                  | —                                  | —                   |
| `authorSlug`   | string               | —                                  | —                   |
| `categoryId`   | int                  | —                                  | —                   |
| `categorySlug` | string               | —                                  | —                   |
| `ids`          | int, comma-separated | —                                  | —                   |
| `isFeatured`   | bool                 | —                                  | —                   |
| `order`        | enum                 | `desc`                             | `asc`, `desc`       |
| `page`         | int                  | `1`                                | —                   |
| `perPage`      | int                  | `12` public, `20` admin, max `100` | —                   |
| `q`            | string               | —                                  | —                   |
| `sort`         | enum                 | per endpoint                       | `newest`, `popular` |
| `tagId`        | int                  | —                                  | —                   |
| `tagSlug`      | string               | —                                  | —                   |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

```http
GET /articles?perPage=2
Accept: application/json
```

| `websiteUrl` | url                                            | `nullable\|url`                          | `null`        |
| `category`   | enum (developer, bank, legal, interior, other) | `in:developer,bank,legal,interior,other` | `"developer"` |
| `order`      | int                                            | `integer\|min:0`                         | `0`           |
| `isActive`   | bool                                           | `boolean`                                | `true`        |

**Example**

```http
PATCH /admin/partners/7
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "isActive": true
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "websiteUrl": null,
    "category": "developer",
    "order": 0,
    "isActive": true,
    "id": 7,
    "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "name": "Smoke name example-adminpartners-3",
    "logoUrl": "https://example.com/smoke-test.png"
  }

```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- An `order` change renumbers the whole collection `1..n` (§5.8).

### POST /admin/partners/bulk

> Apply one action to several partners

- **Registry key** `adminPartners.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/partners/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    7
  ],
  "action": "activate"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 1
  },
  "message": "1 partner updated."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

| `requirement.timeline`       | enum (immediate, 1-3-months, 3-6-months, 6-12-months, exploring) | `nullable\|in:immediate,1-3-months,3-6-months,6-12-months,exploring` | `null`           |
| `consent`                    | bool                                             | `boolean`                                        | `false`          |
| `utm`                        | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`           |
| `utm.source`                 | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:120`                      | `null`           |
| `utm.medium`                 | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:120`                      | `null`           |
| `utm.campaign`               | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:120`                      | `null`           |
| `utm.term`                   | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:120`                      | `null`           |
| `utm.content`                | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:120`                      | `null`           |
| `meta`                       | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`           |
| `website`                    | string                                           | `nullable\|string\|max:200`                      | `null`           |

**Example**

_Not captured: captured from the fixture the run created._

**Error cases**

- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `409` — the slug or e-mail is taken (§5.9)
- `429` — more than ten a minute from one IP (§5.11)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Sets `status: "new"` and `priority` from `siteSettings.leads.defaultPriority`.
- Appends the `created` activity.
- Increments the named property’s `enquiryCount`.
- Auto-assigns round-robin when `siteSettings.leads.autoAssign` says so.
- Stores `utm`, `pageUrl`, `ipAddress` and `userAgent`.
- Answers a lead about an active listing with `access.token`, which opens that listing’s gated files for 24 hours (`POST /properties/:id/documents/access`). The token is never stored on the lead.

### POST /admin/leads/bulk

> Change status, priority or assignee of several leads, or delete them

- **Registry key** `adminLeads.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/leads/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    999999
  ],
  "action": "delete"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 0
  },
  "message": "0 leads deleted."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

### DELETE /admin/localities/:id

> Delete a locality; 409 when it is still in use

- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Null`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

```http
DELETE /admin/localities/23
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": null,
  "message": "Deleted"
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `409` — the record is still in use; `data.usedBy` lists what uses it
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- The slug is freed, and the public URL starts answering 404 (§5.9).

- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)

### DELETE /admin/developers/:id

> Delete a developer; 409 when it is still in use

- **Registry key** `adminDevelopers.remove`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Null`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
DELETE /admin/developers/11
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": null,
  "message": "Deleted"
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `409` — the record is still in use; `data.usedBy` lists what uses it
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- The slug is freed, and the public URL starts answering 404 (§5.9).

### POST /admin/developers/bulk

> Apply one action to several developers

- **Registry key** `adminDevelopers.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/developers/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    9
  ],
  "action": "activate"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 1
  },
  "message": "1 developer updated."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

- **Registry key** `adminMedia.get`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Media`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter   | Type | Default | Allowed values |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | -------------- |
| `withUsage` | bool | —       | —              |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /admin/media/1
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "url": "https://picsum.photos/seed/sna-locality-whitefield/1600/900",
    "publicId": null,
    "provider": "external",
    "type": "image",
    "width": 1600,
    "height": 900,
    "bytes": null,
    "format": "jpg",
    "alt": "Whitefield, Bengaluru",
    "title": null,
    "folder": "localities",
    "tags": [
      "locality",
      "east"
    ],
    "createdBy": 1,
    "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "usedIn": [
      {
        "type": "locality",
        "id": 1,
        "title": "Whitefield"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### PUT /admin/media/:id

> Replace a media item with the full record from the form

- **Registry key** `adminMedia.update`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Media`
- **Body schema** `media.update`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `media.update` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field      | Type                          | Laravel rule                        | Default        |
| ---------- | ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------- |
| `url`      | url                           | `required\|url`                     | —              |
| `publicId` | string                        | `nullable\|string\|max:200`         | `null`         |
| `provider` | enum (cloudinary, external)   | `required\|in:cloudinary,external`  | `"cloudinary"` |
| `type`     | enum (image, video, document) | `required\|in:image,video,document` | `"image"`      |
| `width`    | int                           | `nullable\|integer\|min:0`          | `null`         |
| `height`   | int                           | `nullable\|integer\|min:0`          | `null`         |
| `bytes`    | int                           | `nullable\|integer\|min:0`          | `null`         |
| `format`   | string                        | `nullable\|string\|max:20`          | `null`         |
| `alt`      | string                        | `required\|string\|max:200`         | —              |
| `title`    | string                        | `nullable\|string\|max:200`         | `null`         |
| `folder`   | string                        | `nullable\|string\|max:120`         | `null`         |
| `tags`     | string[]                      | `array`                             | `[]`           |
| `tags.*`   | string                        | `string\|max:60`                    | —              |

**Example**

```http
PUT /admin/media/390
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "url": "https://picsum.photos/seed/smoke-example-adminmedia-3/1200/800",
  "provider": "cloudinary",
  "type": "image",
  "alt": "Smoke alt example-adminmedia-3"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "publicId": null,
    "provider": "cloudinary",
    "type": "image",
    "width": null,
    "height": null,
    "bytes": null,
    "format": null,
    "title": null,
    "folder": null,
    "tags": [],
    "createdBy": 1,
    "id": 390,
    "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "url": "https://picsum.photos/seed/smoke-example-adminmedia-3/1200/800",
    "alt": "Smoke alt example-adminmedia-3",
    "updatedBy": 2,
    "usedIn": []
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `409` — the slug or e-mail is taken (§5.9)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### POST /admin/media/bulk

> Apply one action to several media items

- **Registry key** `adminMedia.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/media/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    999999
  ],
  "action": "delete"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 0
  },
  "message": "0 files deleted."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

### GET /properties/featured

> Featured properties, ordered by priority then recency

- **Registry key** `properties.featured`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `PropertyList`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter            | Type                  | Default                            | Allowed values                                   |
| -------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `amenityIds`         | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `areaUnit`           | enum                  | —                                  | `sqft`, `sqm`, `sqyd`, `acre`, `cent`, `guntha`  |
| `availability`       | enum                  | —                                  | `available`, `sold`, `rented`, `reserved`        |
| `badgeIds`           | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `bedrooms`           | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `cityId`             | int                   | —                                  | —                                                |
| `constructionStatus` | enum, comma-separated | —                                  | `pre-launch`, `under-construction`, `ready-to-move`, `resale` |
| `developerId`        | int                   | —                                  | —                                                |
| `facing`             | enum, comma-separated | —                                  | `north`, `south`, `east`, `west`, `north-east`, `north-west`, `south-east`, `south-west` |
| `furnishing`         | enum, comma-separated | —                                  | `unfurnished`, `semi-furnished`, `fully-furnished` |
| `ids`                | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `isFeatured`         | bool                  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `isVerified`         | bool                  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `listingType`        | enum                  | —                                  | `sale`, `rent`, `lease`                          |
| `localityId`         | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `maxArea`            | number                | —                                  | —                                                |
| `maxPrice`           | number                | —                                  | —                                                |
| `minArea`            | number                | —                                  | —                                                |
| `minPrice`           | number                | —                                  | —                                                |
| `perPage`            | int                   | `12` public, `20` admin, max `100` | —                                                |
| `possessionBy`       | string                | —                                  | —                                                |
| `propertyTypeId`     | int, comma-separated  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `reraRegistered`     | bool                  | —                                  | —                                                |
| `segment`            | string                | —                                  | —                                                |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /properties/featured?perPage=2
Accept: application/json
```

### GET /properties/slug/:slug

> Property details by slug; 404 when inactive

- **Registry key** `properties.bySlug`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `Property`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /properties/slug/lakeview-heights-3-bhk-whitefield
Accept: application/json
```

**Error cases**

- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### GET /properties/:id/similar

> Admin-selected similar properties, topped up to six by locality and type

- **Registry key** `properties.similar`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `PropertyList`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default                            | Allowed values |
| --------- | ---- | ---------------------------------- | -------------- |
| `perPage` | int  | `12` public, `20` admin, max `100` | —              |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /properties/1/similar?perPage=2
Accept: application/json
```

### POST /properties/:id/view

> Count one property view; debounced per IP per hour

- **Registry key** `properties.view`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `ViewCount`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
POST /properties/1/view
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "viewCount": 0
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Increments `viewCount`, once per IP per property per hour.
- Appends a `propertyViews` row, which the dashboard trend reads.

### POST /properties/:id/documents/access

- **Registry key** `properties.documentAccess`
- **Minimum role** none — public
- **Response shape** `DocumentAccess`

_None._

```http
POST /properties/1/documents/access

{
```

**Error cases**

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `user` (§7)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### POST /admin/properties

> Create a property

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.create`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Property`
- **Body schema** `property.create`

**Query parameters**

_None._

- Stamps `publishedAt` the first time `isActive` becomes true.

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `user` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### PUT /admin/properties/:id

> Replace a property with the full record from the form

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.update`
- **Minimum role** `manager`

- **Body schema** `property.update`

_None._

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `409` — the slug or e-mail is taken (§5.9)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Stamps `publishedAt` the first time `isActive` becomes true.

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Stamps `publishedAt` the first time `isActive` becomes true.

### DELETE /admin/properties/:id

> Delete a property; 409 when it is still in use

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.remove`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Null`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
DELETE /admin/properties/43
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": null,
  "message": "Deleted"
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `404` — no such record, or it is outside the caller’s scope (§5.10)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- The slug is freed, and the public URL starts answering 404 (§5.9).

### POST /admin/properties/bulk

> Apply one action to several properties

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/properties/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    41
  ],
  "action": "activate"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 1
  },
  "message": "1 property updated."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

### GET /admin/properties/check-slug

> Check whether a property slug is free and suggest an alternative

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.checkSlug`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `SlugCheck`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter   | Type   | Default | Allowed values |
| ----------- | ------ | ------- | -------------- |
| `excludeId` | int    | —       | —              |
| `slug`      | string | —       | —              |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /admin/properties/check-slug?slug=lakeview-heights-3-bhk-whitefield
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "available": false,
    "suggestion": "lakeview-heights-3-bhk-whitefield-2"
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### POST /admin/properties/:id/duplicate

> Copy a property as an inactive draft with a fresh slug

- **Registry key** `adminProperties.duplicate`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `Property`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/properties/1/duplicate
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{

}
```

- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)

**Side effects**

- Creates an inactive copy with a `-copy` slug and the counters reset.
- Copies every child row and both pivots.

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/redirects/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    4
  ],
  "action": "activate"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 1
  },
  "message": "1 redirect updated."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.

## Module: users

### GET /admin/users

> List users for the admin table

- **Registry key** `adminUsers.list`
- **Minimum role** `manager`
- **Response shape** `UserList`
- **Body schema** none

**Query parameters**

| Parameter  | Type                 | Default                            | Allowed values              |
| ---------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `ids`      | int, comma-separated | —                                  | —                           |
| `isActive` | bool                 | —                                  | —                           |
| `order`    | enum                 | `desc`                             | `asc`, `desc`               |
| `page`     | int                  | `1`                                | —                           |
| `perPage`  | int                  | `12` public, `20` admin, max `100` | —                           |
| `q`        | string               | —                                  | —                           |
| `role`     | enum                 | —                                  | `admin`, `manager`, `sales` |
| `sort`     | string               | per endpoint                       | —                           |

**Request body**

_This endpoint takes no request body._

**Example**

```http
GET /admin/users?perPage=2
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a manager token>
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Admin User",
      "email": "admin@squaresnacres.com",
      "role": "admin",
      "phone": "9880000010",
      "avatarUrl": null,
      "isActive": true,
      "lastLoginAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
      "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Manager User",
      "email": "manager@squaresnacres.com",
      "role": "manager",
      "phone": "9880000011",
      "avatarUrl": null,
      "isActive": true,
      "lastLoginAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
      "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "perPage": 2,
    "total": 3,
    "totalPages": 2
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `manager` (§7)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### POST /admin/users

> Create a user

- **Registry key** `adminUsers.create`
- **Minimum role** `admin`
- **Response shape** `User`
- **Body schema** `user.create`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `user.create` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field       | Type                         | Laravel rule                            | Default   |
| ----------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `name`      | string                       | `required\|string\|min:2\|max:80`       | —         |
| `email`     | email                        | `required\|email`                       | —         |
| `password`  | string                       | `required\|string\|min:8\|max:100`      | —         |
| `role`      | enum (admin, manager, sales) | `required\|in:admin,manager,sales`      | `"sales"` |
| `phone`     | phone                        | `nullable\|regex:/^(\+91)?[6-9]\d{9}$/` | `null`    |
| `avatarUrl` | url                          | `nullable\|url`                         | `null`    |
| `isActive`  | bool                         | `boolean`                               | `true`    |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/users
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a admin token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Smoke name example-adminusers-2",
  "email": "smoke.email.example-adminusers-2@example.com",
  "password": "Smoke password example-adminusers-2",
  "role": "sales"
}
```

**201** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "role": "sales",
    "phone": null,
    "avatarUrl": null,
    "isActive": true,
    "lastLoginAt": null,
    "name": "Smoke name example-adminusers-2",
    "email": "smoke.email.example-adminusers-2@example.com",
    "id": 5,
    "createdAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `admin` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `409` — the slug or e-mail is taken (§5.9)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

_None beyond writing the record._

### POST /admin/users/bulk

> Apply one action to several users

- **Registry key** `adminUsers.bulk`
- **Minimum role** `admin`
- **Response shape** `BulkResult`
- **Body schema** `bulk`

**Query parameters**

_None._

**Request body**

Schema `bulk` (`src/services/schemas/`).

| Field     | Type                                             | Laravel rule                                     | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `ids`     | int[]                                            | `required\|array\|min:1`                         | —       |
| `ids.*`   | int                                              | `integer`                                        | —       |
| `action`  | enum (activate, deactivate, delete, feature, unfeature, verify, unverify, publish, unpublish, assign, status, priority) | `required\|in:activate,deactivate,delete,feature,unfeature,verify,unverify,publish,unpublish,assign,status,priority` | —       |
| `payload` | object                                           | `nullable\|array`                                | `null`  |

**Example**

```http
POST /admin/users/bulk
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <a admin token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "ids": [
    4
  ],
  "action": "activate"
}
```

**200** `application/json`

```json
{
  "data": {
    "affected": 1
  },
  "message": "1 user updated."
}
```

**Error cases**

- `401` — the token is missing, expired or revoked (§5.4)
- `403` — the role may not do this; minimum `admin` (§7)
- `422` — validation failed, `errors` keyed by field (§5.3)
- `500` — the §5.3 envelope, never a stack trace

**Side effects**

- Applies one action to every id, in one transaction; `affected` counts what changed.
